scenario: CV-7 ([LGRA.2.9.6.2]) — string interpolation is NOT a concrete-value position: a null renders as "", so `{s.state}` on a `Float?` compiles.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float? mutable

schema Out scope logical:
    k: String key
    val: Float mutable

schema OutN scope logical:
    k: String key
    maybe: Float? mutable

rule r:
    Sensor s
->
    log info "state {s.state}"
